blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models increasingly tackle hard reasoning problems by spending more test-time compute, yet the dominant strategy remains naive repeated sampling: draw many independent solutions and hope one is correct. Because such sampling explores only through local decoding noise, it tends to produce many near duplicate attempts rather than genuinely different ideas. We ask whether exploration can instead be steered at a semantic level, by first sampling problem specific concepts, hints, or strategies and then conditioning answer generation on them. We refine this into a simple, more exploratory procedure that emits many diverse concepts in a single trajectory, and evaluate it on hard problems where repeated sampling struggles.
We then go a step further and make concept generation trainable : a small concept generator is optimized with reinforcement learning so that its concepts maximize the downstream success of a larger, frozen answer generator. On hard mathematical reasoning problems, the trained concept generator substantially improves the answer generator’s pass@k over naive repeated sampling at the same answer generation allocation, surpasses concepts drawn from much larger untuned models, and transfers to answer generators it was never trained against, including a model from a different family. A small model can thus be trained into an effective, reusable search policy for a much larger one.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型越来越多地通过花费更多的测试时间计算来解决硬推理问题,然而主导策略仍然是天真的重复抽样:绘制许多独立的解决方案,希望一个是正确的. 由于这种取样只通过局部解码噪声进行探索,因此往往会产生许多接近重复的尝试,而不是真正不同的想法. 我们问,是否可以在语义层面指导勘探工作,首先取样具体问题的具体概念、提示或策略,然后对这些概念、提示或策略进行限定。 我们把它细化成一个简单,更探索性的程序,将许多不同的概念放入一个单一的轨迹中,并在重复的采样斗争的艰难问题上加以评价.
然后,我们更进一步,使概念生成可以训练:一个小型概念生成器通过强化学习得到优化,从而使其概念最大限度地实现更大、冷冻的答案生成器的下游成功。 在硬数学推理问题上,训练有素的概念生成器大大改进了答案生成器在同一个答案生成分配中天真重复采样的传递@k,超越了从大得多的未调试模型中提取的概念,转移来回答从未训练过的生成器,包括来自不同家庭的模型. 因此,可以将一个小型模式培训成一个有效、可重复使用的搜索政策,以寻找一个更大的模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning has become a central ingredient in training modern large language models (LLMs), particularly for reasoning: a model is improved by sampling its own solutions, scoring them against a verifier or reward, and reinforcing the successful ones ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Olmo et al., 2025 ) . The effectiveness of this loop hinges on exploration. RL can only reinforce, and ultimately distill into the model weights, behaviors that the sampling policy manages to discover in the first place. On a hard problem where the model never stumbles on a correct solution, there is simply no positive signal to learn from. The same bottleneck appears at inference time, where discovering a correct solution among many samples is precisely what test-time scaling relies on ( Snell et al., 2024 ) . In both regimes, progress is limited by the quality of the underlying search policy, which makes the ability to explore the solution space effectively a first class concern rather than an implementation detail.
blocks.zh: 强化学习已经成为培训现代大语言模型(LLMs),特别是推理的一个核心要素:通过取样自己的解决方案,对照核查者或奖励来评分,以及强化成功的解决方案(Shao等人,2024年;Olmo等人,2025年)。 这一循环的有效性取决于探索。 RL只能强化,并最终在模型加权中提炼出采样策略管理后首先发现的行为. 在模型从未偶然找到正确解决方案的难题上,根本就没有从中学习的积极信号。 同样的瓶颈出现在推论时间,在很多样本中发现一个正确的解决方案正是试验时间缩放所依赖的(Snell等人,2024年)。 在这两个制度中,进展受到基本搜索政策质量的限制,这使有效探索解决方案空间的能力成为头等大事,而不是执行细节。

blocks.en: In practice, the dominant form of exploration is repeated sampling: draw many complete answers from the same model and keep those a verifier or judge deems correct ( Brown et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . This explores only indirectly, through local token level decoding noise, and often yields many near duplicate attempts rather than genuinely different ideas. A natural alternative is to separate deciding how to approach a problem from carrying out the solution: first sample high level concepts, hints, theorems, or strategies, and then generate answers conditioned on them. This mirrors how people tackle hard problems, pausing to consider which ideas or tools might apply before committing to a full derivation, diversifying reasoning at a semantic level rather than at the level of individual tokens.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,勘探的主要形式是重复采样:从同一个模型中抽取许多完整的答案,并保持那些验证者或法官认为正确(Brown等人,2024年;Wang等人,2022年). 这种探索只是间接的,通过地方象征层面的解码噪音,往往产生许多接近重复的尝试,而不是真正不同的想法. 一个自然的替代办法是将如何处理一个问题与执行解决方案分开:首先抽样高层次的概念,提示,定理,或者策略,然后生成以它们为条件的答案. 这反映了人们如何解决困难问题,在承诺充分推理之前,缺乏考虑哪些想法或工具可能适用,在语义层面而不是在个人象征层面使推理多样化。

blocks.en: Recent work instantiated this idea as a concept guided sampling pipeline, using one LLM to propose concepts and another to answer conditioned on them ( Handa et al., 2026 ) . In our reproduction, however, its advantage largely vanishes once the repeated sampling baseline is allowed to use exploratory decoding parameters instead of the restrictive ones originally used. We further identify two practical limitations: concepts are produced one at a time in an iterative loop, which is wasteful given that LLMs are autoregressive, and only about one concept is generated per problem on average, sharply limiting the diversity the method was meant to provide.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将这一想法作为指导性取样管道的概念,利用一种LLM提出概念,另一种则以这些概念为条件(Handa等人,2026年)。 然而,在我们复制过程中,一旦允许重复取样基线使用探索性编解码参数,而不是原先使用的限制性参数,其优势就基本消失。 我们进一步确定了两个实际限制:概念在迭代循环中一次产生,这是浪费的,因为有限责任制度是自动递减的,每个问题平均只产生一个概念,大大限制了方法要提供的多样性。

blocks.en: In this paper we revisit concept guided exploration for mathematical reasoning and turn it into a trainable component. We first strengthen the inference time procedure: we generate all concepts in a single trajectory, prompt for detailed and problem specific concepts, and evaluate on hard subsets where naive repeated sampling fails outright. Building on this, we ask whether a small concept generator can be trained , rather than merely prompted, to produce concepts that improve a larger, frozen answer generator that may be impractical to train, or even closed-source. Concretely, we cast exploration itself as an RL problem, but over concepts rather than answers: we train the concept generator with reinforcement learning, rewarding each concept trajectory by the downstream success of the answer generator it steers. On a held-out set of hard problems, this doubles the answer generator’s pass@128, from 19.0 % 19.0\% for naive repeated sampling to 39.2 % 39.2\% at the same answer generation allocation. Moreover, the learned policy behaves as a reusable search strategy rather than a scale effect: a trained 7B concept generator steers a 32B answer generator well enough to surpass the concepts that larger model produces for itself, and it transfers to a 70B answer generator from a different family that it was never trained against. Our contributions are: • Re-evaluating GuidedSampling across all 25 Qwen2.5 CG/AG size pairs (1.5B–32B) on MATH500, we find that its gains largely disappear against an exploration-enabled repeated sampling baseline. • We introduce single trajectory concept generation and RL-train Qwen2.5-7B as a search policy for a frozen Qwen2.5-32B answer generator, raising pass@128 from 19.0 % 19.0\% to 39.2 % 39.2\% on 1k held-out hard DeepMath problems. • The trained 7B CG outperforms an untuned 32B CG and transfers without retraining to Llama-3.3-70B; its gains also persist out of distribution on Omni-MATH 2. • We analyze whether the learned generator improves exploration rather than merely solving problems directly, and study answer leakage, concept relevance, position effects, and the effect of the number of concepts.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们重新审视了指导对数学推理的探索的概念,并将其变成一个可训练的组成部分。 我们首先加强推论时间程序:我们以单一的轨迹产生所有概念,迅速提出详细和有问题的具体概念,并对天真的重复取样完全失败的硬子集进行评价。 在这个基础上,我们询问是否能够训练一个小型的概念生成器,而不仅仅是促使它产生一些概念,来改进一个更大的、冷冻的回答生成器,而这种生成器可能不切实际,甚至闭源。 具体地说,我们把探索本身看作一个RL问题,但超越了概念而不是答案:我们用强化学习来训练概念生成器,通过它所引导的答案生成器的下游成功来奖励每个概念轨迹. 在一系列困难问题上,这将答题机的合格率@128翻了一番,从19.0%的19.0%的天真重复抽样增加到39.2%的39.2%的同一答题生成分配。 此外,所学政策表现为可重复使用的搜索策略,而不是规模效应:训练有素的7B概念生成器能很好地引导一个32B的解答生成器,足以超越更大的模型为自己产生的概念,它能转移给来自不同家庭的70B解答生成器,而它从未被训练过反对. 我们的贡献是:在MATH500上对全部25个Quen2.5 CG/AG大小对(1.5B-32B)进行重新评价指导抽样,我们发现,在勘探带动的重复抽样基准中,其收益基本上消失了。 我们引入了单一轨迹概念生成和RL-train Quen2.5-7B作为冷冻的Quen2.5-32B 答题生成器的搜索政策,在1k的坚硬的DeepMath问题上将Pass@128从19.0% 19.0%提高到39.2% 39.2%. 训练有素的7B CG优于未调节的32B CG,在没有再培训的情况下转让给Llama-3.3-70B;在Omni-MATH 2上分发它的收益也持续存在。 我们分析学习的生成器是否改进了探索,而不是仅仅直接解决问题,研究答案渗漏,概念相关性,位置效应,以及概念数量的影响.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Repeated sampling is a standard way to spend inference-time compute on reasoning, with performance scaling in the number of samples ( Brown et al., 2024 ; Snell et al., 2024 ) and typically paired with self-consistency or verifier-based selection ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) . A complementary line of work decomposes reasoning into intermediate artifacts (plans, hints, or solution sketches) before producing an answer ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Our direct predecessor is the GuidedSampling method of Handa et al. (2026) , which samples concepts from one LLM and conditions a second LLM’s answers on them; unlike them, we find in our reproduction that this advantage largely disappears once the repeated-sampling baseline is allowed to explore ( section 3 ), and we depart from their setup by emitting all concepts in a single trajectory and by training the concept generator for downstream answer generator success rather than using it zero-shot. This also contrasts with tree-search methods such as Tree of Thoughts ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , whose dynamic branching disrupts continuous batching and KV-cache sharing in optimized engines like vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , whereas our single trajectory generation diversifies exploration while preserving standard autoregressive throughput.
blocks.zh: 重复采样是一种在推理上花费推断时间的标准方法,其性能缩放在样本数量上(Brown等人,2024年;Snell等人,2024年),一般配以自相容性或基于核查者的选择(Wang等人,2022年;Lightman等人,2024年). 互补的工作线将推理分解为中间文物(计划,提示,或溶液草图),然后再生成答案(Wang等人,2025年). 我们的直接前身是Handa et al. (2026年)的GuidedSampling方法,它从一个LLM中抽取概念,并以第二个LLM的答案作为条件;与它们不同的是,我们从复制中发现,一旦允许重复的抽样基线(第3节)被探索,这一优势就基本消失,我们偏离了它们的设置,将所有概念放入一个单一的轨道,并培训概念生成器,使其在下游的回答生成器成功,而不是使用零镜头。 这也与思源之树(Yao等人,2023年)等树型搜索方法形成对比,其动态分支干扰了VLLM(Kwon等人,2023年)等优化引擎的连续批量和KV-cache共享,而我们单一的轨迹生成者在保留标准自递性吞吐量的同时进行探索.

blocks.en:
The closest RL-based method is RLAD ( Qu et al., 2025 ) , which trains an abstraction generator to produce procedural summaries that guide a downstream solver. Unlike RLAD, our method uses no SFT warm start based on traces from a stronger teacher, targets concise, problem-specific exploration hints rather than full procedural summaries, and trains only the concept generator.
Like SOAR ( Sundaram et al., 2026 ) , we reward the generator using measured downstream performance rather than an intrinsic proxy, however, our downstream model remains frozen.
Related zero-shot methods elicit similar artifacts without training the generator: Step-Back prompting abstracts a problem to higher-level principles ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , and Auto-CoT synthesizes its own few-shot exemplars ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) (whose gains may stem from problem creation rather than the examples themselves ( Gwak et al., 2026 ) ). In contrast, we train the concept generator with trajectory-level rewards from downstream answer success. Finally, our setup echoes small-model orchestration of larger systems: Directional Stimulus Prompting ( Li et al., 2023 ) trains a small LM to emit hints that guide a frozen black-box LLM, and ToolOrchestra ( Su et al., 2025 ) RL-trains a lightweight orchestrator to coordinate tools and frontier models for efficiency, whereas we steer a single fixed, larger answer generator through concepts, with a trained 7B concept generator improving a 32B answer generator.
blocks.zh:
最近的基于RL的方法是RLAD(Qu等人,2025年),它训练一个抽象生成器来生成程序摘要来引导下游的解析器. 与RLAD不同,我们的方法没有使用基于强师的痕迹的 SFT 温暖的开始,目标简洁,针对具体问题的探索提示而不是完整的程序摘要,只训练概念生成器.
SOAR(Sundaram等人,2026年)一样,我们利用测量的下游性能而不是内在的代名词来奖励发电机,然而,我们的下游模型仍然被冻结。
相关的零射法在不训练生成器的情况下引出类似的文物:Step-Back提示一个问题到更高层次的原则(Zheng等人,2024年),Auto-CoT合成了自己的几发样本(Zhang等人,2022年)(其收益可能来自问题创造而不是实例本身(Gwak等人,2026年)). 与此相对照,我们用下游的答题成功带来的轨迹级奖励来训练概念生成器。 最后,我们的布局呼应了大型系统的小型模式: 定向刺激(Li et al., 2023) 训练一个小的LM,以发出提示,引导一个冷冻的黑盒LLM,和TolleOrchestra(Su et al., 2025) RL-trains一个轻量级管弦乐器,以协调提高效率的工具和前沿模型,而我们则通过概念引导一个固定的,更大的回答生成器,训练有素的7B概念生成器改进一个32B的回答生成器.

blocks.en: 3 Background and Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 背景和分析

blocks.en: The method most closely related to ours first samples concepts with one LLM and then uses a second LLM to generate final answers conditioned on those concepts ( Handa et al., 2026 ) . The intended benefit is to explore diverse mathematical ideas before spending the larger answer-generation allocation. In principle, this can produce more semantically diverse rollouts than repeated sampling from the answer generator alone.
blocks.zh: 这种方法与我们的第一个概念样本中有一个LLM最密切相关,然后使用第二个LLM生成以这些概念为条件的最后答案(Handa等人,2026年)。 预定的好处是,在花费更大的答案生成分配之前,先探讨各种数学想法。 原则上,这可以产生比仅从答案生成器中重复取样的更为多样的推广。

blocks.en: Reproduction and Baseline Sensitivity. We reproduce concept-guided sampling on MATH500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) , using Qwen2.5-Instruct models at five sizes ( 1.5 1.5 B, 3 3 B, 7 7 B, 14 14 B, and 32 32 B) as both the concept generator (CG) and the answer generator (AG), and evaluate all 25 25 CG/AG size combinations. Concepts are produced with the original iterative generation procedure and prompts from Handa et al. (2026) , left unchanged. For each problem we draw a total of 100 100 answer rollouts and report pass@ 50 50 : the baseline draws all 100 100 rollouts directly from the AG, whereas the concept-guided condition splits the same 100 100 -rollout allocation across the concepts parsed from the CG trajectory, so the two conditions are matched in answer-generation compute. Only the AG sampling parameters differ from the original protocol.
blocks.zh: 复制和基线敏感性。 我们复制了MATH500(Hendrycks等人,2021年;Lightman等人,2024年)上的概念指导采样,使用五尺寸(1.51.5 B,3 3 B,7 7 B,14 14 B,32 32 B)的Quen2.5-指令模型作为概念生成器(CG)和答案生成器(AG),并评价所有25个CG/AG尺寸组合. 概念是用最初的迭代生成程序和Handa等人(2026年)的提示生成的,未作改动。 对于每个问题,我们总共抽取100 100 个答题并报告通过@ 50 50 :基线直接从AG抽取所有100 个答题,而概念指导条件将同样的100 100 个答题分配从CG轨迹中解析出来,因此这两个条件在答题生成计算中相匹配。 只有AG采样参数与原协议不同.

blocks.en: The reported advantage of concept-guided sampling is highly sensitive to these parameters. The original repeated-sampling baseline used temperature 0.8 0.8 and top- p = 0.5 p=0.5 , which restricts exploration and yields an artificially weak baseline. When both the baseline and the concept-conditioned answer generator are instead sampled with exploratory parameters (temperature 1.0 1.0 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , top- k k disabled, implemented as − 1 -1 ), the concept-guided method no longer improves over repeated sampling and slightly degrades it across nearly all CG/AG pairs. Table 1 reports, for each AG size, the baseline pass@50 (top row) and the pass@50 difference between the concept-guided method and this baseline for every CG (rows) / AG (columns) pair, where negative values indicate underperformance; the final column gives the average number of concepts generated per problem by each CG. Once the baseline is allowed to explore, the gains attributed to concept guidance largely disappear.
blocks.zh: 据报告,概念指导取样的优点对这些参数非常敏感。 最初的重复采样基线使用温度0.8 0.8,顶端-p=0.5 p=0.5,限制了勘探,并产生人工弱基线. 当基线和有概念条件的答案生成器都用探索性参数(温度1.01.0,顶端-p=0.95p=0.95,顶端-kk禁用,作为−1-1实施)进行取样时,概念制导方法不再比重复采样改进,并且几乎在所有CG/AG配对中略微降解. 表1报告每个AG大小的基准通过@50(顶行)和每个CG(rows)/AG(柱)对的概念制导方法与这个基准的差数@50,负值表示性能不佳;最后一栏给出每个CG每个问题产生的平均概念数. 一旦允许探索基线,概念指导带来的收益基本上消失。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Reproduction of concept-guided sampling ( Handa et al., 2026 ) on MATH500 (Qwen2.5-Instruct): baseline pass@50 and concept-guided differences across CG/AG size pairs. Reported gains disappear once the answer generator is allowed to explore freely.
blocks.zh: 表1:在MATH500(Quen2.5-Instructionct)上复制概念制式取样(Handa等人,2026年):基准通过@50和概念制式的跨CG/AG大小对差. 一旦允许答案生成器自由探索,报告的收益便消失。

blocks.en:
We also identify two structural limitations. First, concepts are generated one by one in an iterative loop. This is slow and unnecessary because LLMs are autoregressive and will generate newer concepts conditioned on the older ones. It is then possible to generate a list of diverse concepts in a single trajectory.
Second, the method generates approximately one concept per problem on average ( table 1 ), which defeats the purpose of exploring multiple solution ideas. This low concept count is consistent with the original work, which observes that Qwen2.5 models generate noticeably fewer concepts than their Llama-3.2 counterparts and reports only 1.13 1.13 distinct concepts per problem on HumanEval ( Handa et al., 2026 ) .
The disappearance of gains is not merely an artifact of this low concept count. Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct generates 3.18 3.18 concepts per problem on MATH500, 3 times more than the Qwen models, yet under exploratory sampling concept guidance still does not help: it reaches 86.7 % 86.7\% pass@50 versus 88.1 % 88.1\% for the repeated-sampling baseline (a − 1.4 -1.4 point change). Even when the concept generator produces multiple concepts, allowing the baseline to explore erases the reported advantage, indicating that the baseline sampling parameters, not the number of concepts, drive the effect.
blocks.zh:
我们还确定了两个结构限制。 首先,概念在迭代循环中逐个生成. 这样做是缓慢和不必要的,因为法学硕士是自动递减的,将产生以老概念为条件的新概念。 然后有可能在单一轨迹中生成一个不同概念的清单。
其次,该方法平均每个问题产生大约一个概念(表1),这违背了探索多种解决方案理念的目的. 这一低概念计数与最初的作品一致,该作品认为Qune2.5模型产生的概念明显少于Llama-3.2对应的概念,在HumanEval上只报告每个问题1.13 1.13个不同的概念(Handa等人,2026年).
收益的消失不仅仅是这个低等概念的算数的一件艺术品。 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct在MATH500上每个问题产生3.18 3.18概念,比Quen模型多3倍,但在探索性取样概念指导下仍然无济于事:重复取样基线达到86.7%86.7%通过@50,而88.1%88.1%(一个−1.4-1.4点变化)。 即使在概念生成器产生多个概念时,允许基线探索抹去报告的优势,表明基线采样参数而不是概念数量驱动效应.

blocks.en: These observations motivate our concept-guided sampling procedure in section 4 .
blocks.zh: 这些意见促使我们在第4节中采用概念指导的取样程序。

blocks.en: 4 Concept-Guided Sampling
blocks.zh: 4 概念指导抽样

blocks.en: We first modify concept-guided sampling as an inference-time procedure. The goal is not to train a model yet, but to test whether a better concept-generation protocol can improve exploration beyond naive repeated sampling on problems where the answer generator struggles.
blocks.zh: 我们首先修改了概念指导抽样作为推断时间的程序。 目标不是训练一个模型,而是测试一个更好的概念生成协议除了对答案生成者挣扎的问题进行天真重复抽样之外,能否改进探索.

blocks.en:
Exploratory Answer Generation .
We keep the exploratory decoding parameters introduced in section 3 (temperature 1.0 1.0 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , and top- k = − 1 k=-1 ) for concept-conditioned generation and repeated sampling. This keeps the comparison conservative: any improvement from concepts must exceed what a strong, exploration-enabled repeated-sampling baseline already achieves.
blocks.zh:
探索性答案生成.
我们保留第3节中引入的探索性解码参数(温度1.01.0,顶端-p=0.95p=0.95,顶端-k=−1k=-1),用于概念条件生成和重复采样. 这保持了比较的保守性:与概念相比的任何改进都必须超过一个强大、勘探驱动的重复抽样基准已经实现的目标。

blocks.en:
Single-Trajectory Concept Generation .
Instead of sampling concepts one by one, we prompt the concept generator to analyze the problem and emit all useful concepts in one trajectory. Each concept is required to be high-signal, problem-specific, and non-duplicative. We parse at most ten concepts from the trajectory and condition answer rollouts on those concepts. The full concept-generator and answer-generator prompts are given in sections B.1 and B.2 .
blocks.zh:
单轨概念生成.
我们不逐一地取样概念,而是促使概念生成者分析问题,将所有有用的概念放入一个轨道。 每个概念都需要具有高信号性,问题性,非重复性. 我们从轨迹和条件答案中分析最多十个概念。 B.1节和B.2节给出了完整的概念生成者和答案生成者提示。

blocks.en:
Focusing on Hard Problems .
On easy problems, repeated sampling already solves most examples, leaving little room for concept-guided exploration to help. We therefore construct model specific hard subsets from the MATH test set: for each answer-generator size, we retain only problems for which the repeated-sampling baseline obtains 0 % 0\% accuracy with 100 rollouts. Each answer generator is thus evaluated on its own filtered subset. The hard subsets shrink as the answer generator grows, from 493 493 problems for the 1.5 1.5 B model to 178 178 for the 32 32 B model, since more capable models leave fewer completely unsolved problems.
blocks.zh:
聚焦难题.
在简单问题上,重复采样已经解决了大多数例子,为概念指导的探索留下了很小的空间来提供帮助. 因此,我们从 MATH 测试集中构建模型特定硬子集: 对于每个答案生成器大小,我们只保留了重复抽样基准获得0% 0QQ 精确度并有100个推出的问题. 因此,每个答题生成器都会在自己的过滤子集上进行评估. 硬子集随着解答生成器的增长而收缩,从1.5 B型的493 493个问题,到32 32 B型的178 178个问题,因为更有能力的模型留下的完全未解决的问题较少.

blocks.en: Inference time results. In contrast to the reproduction in section 3 , where concept guidance never helped once the baseline was allowed to explore, our procedure produces consistent gains on the hard subsets ( table 2 ). Almost every concept-generator (CG) / answer-generator (AG) pair improves over the repeated-sampling baseline, with gains of up to + 9.7 +9.7 pass@50 points. The improvements scale with the strength of the concept generator: the 1.5 1.5 B generator helps only marginally, whereas generators of 7 7 B and larger improve nearly every answer generator by several points. Running the iterative protocol ( Handa et al., 2026 ) on these same hard subsets with the same AG sampling parameters also yields gains, but smaller ones (at most + 6.8 +6.8 points, with several regressions), consistent with its far lower concept count ( section D.5 ).
blocks.zh: 推论时间结果. 与此相反,我们的程序在硬子集(表2)上产生一致的收益。 几乎每个概念生成者(CG)/答-生成者(AG)对比重复采样基准改进,得分最高为+9.7+9.7通过@50分. 改进的规模与概念发电机的强度相同:1.5 B型发电机的作用不大,而7 7 B型和更大的发电机几乎每台答题发电机都改进了几个点。 对这些具有相同AG采样参数的相同的硬子集进行迭代协议(Handa et al., 2026 )也产生收益,但收益较小(最多+ 6.8+6.8分,有多个回归),符合其远低的概念计数(D.5节).

blocks.en: Most importantly, a small concept generator can improve a much larger answer generator. The 7 7 B generator raises the 32 32 B answer generator by + 8.8 +8.8 points despite being far smaller than the model it steers, indicating that useful exploration can be produced with little compute and injected into a stronger, possibly frozen or closed-source, answer generator. This observation directly motivates the training setup in section 5 , where a small concept generator is trained for a larger, fixed answer generator. An example of generated concepts with our approach is given in section 4 .
blocks.zh: 最重要的是,一个小的概念生成器可以改进一个大得多的解答生成器. 7 7 B型发电机虽然比它所引导的模型要小得多,但还是以+8.8+8.8分提高32 B型答录发电机,表明有用的探索可以在很少计算的情况下产生,并注入更强的,可能冷冻或闭源的答录发电机. 这一观察直接激发了第5节中的培训设置,其中一个小型的概念生成器被训练用于一个更大的,固定的回答生成器. 第4节举例说明了我们的做法所产生的概念。

blocks.en: These gains coincide with a large increase in the number of concepts. Whereas the original procedure produced about one concept per problem ( table 1 ), single-trajectory generation yields between 4 4 and roughly 10 10 concepts on average, with the stronger generators saturating the cap of ten.
blocks.zh: 这些成果与概念数量大幅增加相吻合。 最初的程序产生了大约每个问题一个概念(表1),而单射电生成平均在4-4至约10个概念之间,较强的发电机饱和10个上限。

You reach into the bag and pull out a bead, replacing it with a red bead regardless of the color you pulled out. What is the probability that all beads in the bag are red after three such replacements? Express your answer as a common fraction. Example concepts: • Use a tree diagram to map all possible outcomes of the draws and replacements. • Calculate the probability for each state transition step-by-step. • Analyze the problem using a Markov chain to model the transitions between states.

blocks.en:
Cross-family check. Our reported gains are not specific to the Qwen family. On a hard subset of 424 424 MATH problems that Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct fails to solve with 100 100 rollouts, our single-trajectory procedure (using Llama-3.2-3B as both concept and answer generator) yields a modest but positive improvement, raising pass@50 from 25.2 % 25.2\% to 26.1 % 26.1\% ( + 0.9 +0.9 points), while producing 9.23 9.23 concepts per problem on average, far more than the one to three produced by the original iterative procedure of Handa et al. (2026) ; see section 3 .
Notably, that original procedure degraded this same model’s exploratory baseline; switching to single-trajectory generation both increases concept diversity and flips the effect positive, confirming the improvement is not an artifact of the Qwen family.
blocks.zh:
跨家庭检查。 我们所报告的收益并非是Quen家族特有的。 在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct以100 100推出方式未能解决的424 424 MATH问题硬子上,我们的单轨程序(既使用Llama-3.2-3B作为概念,又使用答案生成器)取得了微小但积极的改进,将通过@50从25.2% 25.2\%提高到26.1% 26.1\%(+0.9+0.9分),同时平均每问题产生9.23 9.23个概念,远远超过汉达等人最初的迭代程序产生的1-3个概念(2026);见第3节。
值得注意的是,最初的程序使这个模型的探索性基线退化;转换为单轨生成既增加了概念的多样性,又翻转了正面效果,证实改进并非Quen家族的杰作。

blocks.en: 5 Training Concept Generators
blocks.zh: 5个培训概念生成器

blocks.en: The inference time results raise a natural question: can we train a small model to generate better concepts for a larger answer generator? This is useful because the larger answer generator may be impractical to train directly or its weights unavailable. In particular, this provides a “training handle” for otherwise untrainable models, including those only accessible via API. Throughout, the answer generator remains frozen and only the concept generator is trained. Figure 1 summarizes the full training loop, and appendix A gives the formal setting with a fuller discussion of the reward design.
blocks.zh: 推论时间结果提出了一个自然的问题:我们能否训练一个小模型来为更大的答案生成器产生更好的概念? 这样做是有用的,因为较大的答题生成器可能不切实际,无法直接进行训练,或其重量无法使用。 特别是,这为本无法培训的模式,包括只能通过API获得的模式,提供了一个“培训手柄”。 在整个过程中,解答生成器仍然冷冻,只有概念生成器得到训练. 图1总结了整个培训流程,附录A提供了正式设置,更充分地讨论了奖励设计。

blocks.en:
Concept sampling and answer rollouts .
Let x x denote an input problem and π θ \pi_{\theta} the concept generator (CG); the answer generator (AG) is a fixed model used only for inference. For each problem, π θ \pi_{\theta} samples G G trajectories. Each trajectory contains a problem analysis followed by a list of concepts. We parse the generated text and keep at most 10 10 concepts. For each concept trajectory, we assign a total answer-rollout allocation of B B calls to the answer generator (AG). The allocation is distributed as evenly as possible across the parsed concepts: if M M concepts are available, each concept receives either ⌊ B / M ⌋ \lfloor B/M\rfloor or ⌈ B / M ⌉ \lceil B/M\rceil rollouts, with the total number of rollouts equal to B B . This handles cases such as B = 128 B=128 and M = 10 M=10 , where some concepts receive 13 13 rollouts and the rest receive 12 12 .

Reward aggregation .
Each AG rollout is graded for correctness against the ground-truth answer using an LLM judge.
We use an LLM judge because, even after extracting the final answer, rule-based matching can penalize mathematically equivalent answers expressed in different forms or formats.
We then aggregate the rollout scores into a scalar reward for the entire concept trajectory. Consider a trajectory τ \tau with parsed concepts c 1 , … , c M c_{1},\dots,c_{M} , where concept c j c_{j} receives n j n_{j} answer rollouts with binary correctness o j , ℓ ∈ { 0 , 1 } o_{j,\ell}\in\{0,1\} . We consider two aggregation functions, r max-max ​ ( τ ) = max j ⁡ max ℓ ​ o j , ℓ , r max-mean ​ ( τ ) = max j ⁡ 1 n j ​ ∑ ℓ = 1 n j o j , ℓ . r_{\text{max-max}}(\tau)=\max_{j}\max_{\ell}\,o_{j,\ell},\qquad r_{\text{max-mean}}(\tau)=\max_{j}\frac{1}{n_{j}}\sum_{\ell=1}^{n_{j}}o_{j,\ell}. Max-of-mean takes the maximum over concepts of the per-concept accuracy; it rewards concepts that are reliably useful rather than concepts that only occasionally lead to a correct sample. The two aggregations therefore differ in range: max-of-max yields a binary reward in { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} , whereas max-of-mean yields a continuous reward in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .

Trajectory-level credit .
To encourage a diverse set of concepts, we assign the aggregate reward to the entire concept trajectory instead of attributing reward to individual concepts. This encourages exploration over sets of concepts, but it may introduce position effects or allow weak concepts to share credit with strong ones. We study these effects in section D.2 .

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 设置

blocks.en: We now test our approach introduced in the previous section to train the CG model.
blocks.zh: 我们现在测试上一节中介绍的训练CG模式的方法.

blocks.en: Models. We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the trainable concept generator and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct as the primary answer generator ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . The answer generator is kept fixed and used solely for inference. The transfer experiments in section 7 further use Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) as an answer generator.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们使用Quen2.5-7B-Instruct作为可训练概念生成器,Quen2.5-32B-Instruct作为主答生成器(杨等人,2024年). 答案生成器被固定下来,仅用于推论. 第7节中的转移实验进一步使用Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct(Grattafiori等人,2024年)作为解答生成器.

blocks.en: Data. Training uses problems and ground truths from DeepMath-103k ( He et al., 2026 ) . We filter the training set using the answer generator and retain problems where the AG achieves less than 5 % 5\% success with 128 rollouts. As the held-out evaluation set we reserve 1 1 k problems, disjoint from training, where the AG achieves 0 % 0\% success with 128 rollouts; these are the hardest problems for the answer generator and are used for all main results. Because this filter is a finite-sample estimate, a fresh independent draw can still solve a fraction of these problems; we quantify this effect in section D.6 . To test generalization beyond the training distribution, we additionally evaluate on Omni-MATH 2 ( Ballon et al., 2026 ) , itself a filtered version of Omni-MATH ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , which we filter with the exact same procedure (retaining problems where the AG achieves 0 % 0\% success with 128 rollouts) to obtain an out-of-distribution hard set. We do not train on this dataset; it is used only for evaluation, following the same protocol as the DeepMath held-out set.

blocks.en: Training Algorithm. We train the CG with GRPO-style reinforcement learning, using the variant adopted in OLMo3 ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) . For each problem, the CG samples G = 8 G=8 concept trajectories. Each trajectory receives a downstream reward computed from B = 128 B=128 AG rollouts. Because computing each trajectory reward requires many AG rollouts, we do not use dynamic/active sampling during training. We train for 200 batches and report both reward-aggregation variants defined in section 5 (max-of-max and max-of-mean). Detailed hyperparameters are reported in appendix C .
blocks.zh: 训练算术. 我们使用OLMo3(Olmo等人,2025年)采用的变体,用GRPO式的强化学习来训练CG. 对于每个问题,CG样本G=8G=8概念轨迹. 每条航道都得到从B=128 B=128 AG推出计算的下游奖励。 由于计算每个轨迹奖励都需要许多AG的推出,因此在训练期间我们不使用动态/主动采样. 我们为200批次进行训练,并报告第5节(最大和最大)界定的奖励-汇总变体。 详细超参数见附录C。

blocks.en: Answer Generation and Judging. The AG uses temperature 1.0 1.0 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , top- k = − 1 k=-1 , a maximum response length of 4096 tokens, and a maximum prompt length of 2048 tokens. We judge answer correctness with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using greedy decoding and a binary verifier prompt. blocks.en: 6.2 Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 结果

blocks.en: Main Results. The trained concept generators substantially improve pass@k over naive repeated sampling on the held-out hard problems ( table 3 ). The best variant (max-of-mean) reaches 39.2 % 39.2\% pass@128, roughly double the 19.0 % 19.0\% of naive repeated sampling, and the gap holds at smaller allocations ( 29.6 % 29.6\% vs. 11.4 % 11.4\% at pass@64). A generic, problem-agnostic prompt modification helps only modestly ( 22.6 % 22.6\% pass@128), far below problem-specific concepts. Both aggregation objectives improve over the baselines, with max-of-mean ahead of max-of-max at every allocation ( 39.2 % 39.2\% vs. 35.3 % 35.3\% pass@128). This indicates the CG learns to propose problem-specific directions that reshape the AG’s exploration distribution rather than merely drawing more samples from the same distribution. We verify this exploration effect directly: embedding the generated chains of thought and measuring their diversity with the Vendi Score shows that concept guidance, and especially the trained CG, produces more diverse reasoning than naive sampling ( section D.8 ). The improvement carries over to the out-of-distribution Omni-MATH 2 set, where max-of-mean is again the best method ( 18.6 % 18.6\% vs. 11.3 % 11.3\% pass@128 for naive), though margins are smaller and max-of-max there only matches the untrained concept generators. The main table reports the headline allocations k ∈ { 1 , 64 , 128 } k\in\{1,64,128\} ; the full pass@k curves for all methods and both datasets, together with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and paired-bootstrap tests of the gains over naive sampling, are reported in section D.7 . We train for 200 200 steps throughout; section D.9 shows that training substantially longer yields no sustained gain: performance saturates after a few hundred steps, and the max-of-mean objective eventually becomes unstable, which justifies this choice.

blocks.en: Small Concept Generators Can Help Larger Answer Generators. A central finding is that a small trained CG outperforms a much larger untrained one. Without training, a larger concept generator does help more, consistent with scale: the untuned 32B CG reaches 33.8 % 33.8\% pass@128 versus 28.9 % 28.9\% for the untuned 7B CG. After RL training, however, the 7B CG surpasses the untuned 32B CG ( 39.2 % 39.2\% vs. 33.8 % 33.8\% pass@128 for max-of-mean, and 35.3 % 35.3\% for max-of-max), despite steering an answer generator more than four times its size. This supports the view that the concept generator learns a specialized search policy rather than relying on model scale, and that useful exploration can be produced with little compute and injected into a larger frozen answer generator. A paired bootstrap over held-out problems confirms this gap: + 5.4 +5.4 points pass@128 on DeepMath and + 3.3 +3.3 on Omni-MATH 2, with both 95 % 95\% intervals excluding 0 0 ( table 9 in section D.7 ).

blocks.en: Comparison to Inference-Time Concept Sampling. The untuned concept generators in table 3 are exactly the inference-time procedure of section 4 , and they already improve over naive sampling ( 28.9 % 28.9\% pass@128 for the 7B CG). RL training adds a further + 10.3 +10.3 points over the untuned CG, showing that training improves concept quality. section D.10 shows qualitative examples of how training reshapes generated concepts into more concrete, problem-specific plans. We confirm this improvement is statistically significant with a paired bootstrap over held-out problems (per-problem difference of the two unbiased pass@k estimates); table 10 in section D.7 reports the trained over untuned 7B gain for both reward objectives and datasets.
blocks.zh: 与推论-时间概念抽样比较. 表3中未经调整的概念生成器恰恰是第4节的推论时间程序,它们已经比天真取样有所改进(7B CG的28.9% 28.9%通过@128)。 RL培训比未调整的CG再增加10.3+10.3分,表明培训提高了概念质量. D.10节举例说明了培训如何将概念重塑成更具体、针对具体问题的计划。 我们确认,这种改进在统计上具有重大意义,在被搁置的问题上(两个不带偏见的通行证的每个问题差异@k估计数);D.7节表10报告训练有素的7B增益超过奖励目标和数据集。

blocks.en: 7 Analysis and Ablations
blocks.zh: 7 分析和缺陷

blocks.en: 7.1 Do Problem-Relevant Concepts Matter?
blocks.zh: 7.1 与问题有关的概念是否重要?

blocks.en:
We test whether the gains come from problem-specific guidance or merely from perturbing the prompt. Using the trained CG concepts (max-of-mean), we apply a random derangement over the held-out set so that each problem is paired with another problem’s concept trajectory (no problem keeps its own), and re-run answer generation.
Mismatched concepts still help slightly over naive sampling ( 23.9 % 23.9\% vs. 19.0 % 19.0\% pass@128), on par with the generic prompt-modification baseline ( 22.6 % 22.6\% pass@128), consistent with a concept from an unrelated problem acting as a generic perturbation. But they fall far short of matched concepts ( 39.2 % 39.2\% pass@128): problem relevance accounts for roughly 15 15 of the 20 20 point improvement over naive sampling. This indicates that most of the benefit comes from problem-specific concepts, not from generic prompt perturbation.
blocks.zh:
我们检验这些收益是来自针对特定问题的指导,还是仅仅来自干扰及时性。 使用训练有素的CG概念(max-of-emain),我们对被搁置的设定进行随机偏差,使每个问题都与另一个问题的概念轨迹(没有问题保留自己的)搭配,并重新运行答案生成。
错误的概念仍然比天真抽样稍有帮助(23.9% 23.9%对19.0% 19.0%通过@128),与通用即时修改基线(22.6% 22.6%通过@128)相同,符合一个不相关问题的概念。 但是,它们远远没有达到匹配的概念(39.2%的39.2+%通过@128):问题的相关性在20个20点改进中大约占15个15个,比天真抽样要好。 这表明,大部分好处来自特定问题的概念,而不是一般的即时扰动。

blocks.zh: 7.2 跨数据集和模型的传输

blocks.en:
Cross-model transfer. Our concept generator is trained only against the Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct answer generator and never sees Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) during training. To test whether the learned search policy transfers, we take the trained 7B CG and use it to steer Llama-3.3-70B, a larger model from a different family, on both the 1k DeepMath held-out set and the Omni-MATH 2 set. We reuse both filtered sets exactly as in section 6 (filtered so the Qwen2.5-32B AG scores 0 % 0\% , and reused as-is rather than re-filtered for Llama), so they measure transfer on common hard sets rather than Llama’s own worst-case problems. Accordingly the Llama baseline is non-zero, solving 6.2 % 6.2\% of the DeepMath problems at pass@1. For all rows we judge correctness with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, consistent with our earlier experiments.
As shown in table 4 , on DeepMath the transferred CG is best at every k k value, reaching 34.3 % 34.3\% pass@128 versus 26.2 % 26.2\% for naive sampling and 28.9 % 28.9\% for Llama generating its own concepts. The small trained CG thus outperforms the 10 × 10\times larger answer generator’s self-generated concepts, despite never being trained against it.
This indicates the CG learns a transferable exploration policy rather than one tied to a specific AG.
blocks.zh:
跨型转移. 我们的概念生成器只接受对Quen2.5-32B-指令响应生成器的训练,在训练期间从未看到Llama-3.3-70B-指令(Grattafiori等人,2024年). 为了测试学习到的搜索政策转移,我们采用了训练有素的7B CG,并用它来引导来自不同家庭的更大的模型Llama-3.3-70B在1k DeepMath hold-out集和Omni-MATH 2集上. 我们重新使用两套过滤器,完全如第6节(过滤后Quen2.5-32B AG的分数为0 % ) , 并重新使用,而不是重新过滤给Llama), 因此它们用普通的硬盘而不是Llama自己的最坏情况来测量转移。 因此,Llama基线为非零,解决了6.2%的深玛斯问题,通过@1. 对于所有行,我们用Quen2.5-32B指令来判断正确性,这与我们先前的实验一致.
如表4所示,在DeepMath上,转移的CG最好达到每千公里的值,达到34.3% 34.3\%通过@128,而天真取样为26.2% 26.2\%,Llama为28.9% 28.9\%产生自己的概念。 训练有素的小型CG也因此超越了10×10\时较大的答题生成器自我生成的概念,
这表明CG学会了一种可转移的勘探政策,而不是与特定的AG挂钩的政策.

blocks.en: 7.3 Training and Inference Compute
blocks.zh: 7.3 培训和推断

blocks.en: The training loop of our approach ( section 5 ) is compute-heavy, and this compute is almost entirely dominated by reward estimation. Before a single gradient is taken, scoring the G = 8 G=8 concept trajectories for a problem requires G × B = 1024 G\times B=1024 generations from the frozen answer generator plus 1024 1024 judge calls per problem in the batch. In a representative training step of about 413 413 s, the AG rollouts take ∼ 300 \sim\!300 s and judging ∼ 85 \sim\!85 s (together roughly 94 % 94\% of the step) while generating the concept trajectories with the CG takes only ∼ 18 \sim\!18 s and the actor update about 10 10 s. Training is therefore bottlenecked by repeatedly running the large model we do not train, not by the small concept generator we optimize. Crucially, training is run only once.
blocks.zh: 我们方法(第5节)的训练循环是计算繁重的,这种计算几乎完全以奖励估计为主。 在采用单一梯度前,对一个问题进行G=8 G=8的概念轨迹评分,需要G×B=1024 G\times B=1024代从冻结的答题生成器中加1024 1024名裁判员在批次中每个问题拨打. 在大约413 413 s 的代表性训练步骤中, AG 推出 采取 \ 300\sim\! 300 s 判断 \ 85\sim\! 85 s(共约94%的94\%), 18 s和演员更新约10 10 s. 因此,我们反复运行我们不训练的大型模型,而不是我们优化的小型概念生成器,阻碍了培训。 关键是,培训只进行一次。

With N CG = 7.6 N_{\text{CG}}=7.6 B and N AG = 32.5 N_{\text{AG}}=32.5 B parameters and average lengths of ℓ CG ≈ 280 + 800 = 1080 \ell_{\text{CG}}\approx 280+800=1080 and ℓ AG ≈ 240 + 820 = 1060 \ell_{\text{AG}}\approx 240+820=1060 tokens, this ratio is about 7.6 32.5 ⋅ 1080 1060 ≈ 0.24 \tfrac{7.6}{32.5}\cdot\tfrac{1080}{1060}\approx 0.24 : generating the concepts takes less than a quarter of a single answer rollout. Furthermore, it is under 0.3 % 0.3\% of the B = 128 B=128 rollout answer allocation (we ignore ℓ in \ell_{\text{in}} for the AG due to prefix sharing). Therefore this allocation is essentially the same as naive repeated sampling. We do not add answer rollouts, we only prepend one lightweight small-model call and change how the existing B B rollouts are prompted, so concept-guided exploration runs at essentially the same inference compute as the  baseline.

blocks.en: 7.4 Additional Ablations
blocks.zh: 7.4 额外规定

blocks.en:
We report further analyses in appendix D .
Training the 7B model to answer directly with the same RL algorithm, training split, and judge performs worse than using it as a concept generator for the frozen 32B answer generator, showing that the gain comes from steering a stronger model rather than teaching the small model to solve the problems itself ( section D.1 ).
Per-concept accuracy remains within a narrow range across trajectory positions, and the bootstrap confidence intervals for positions 2–10 broadly overlap: no position is dead, supporting our use of trajectory-level credit assignment ( section D.2 ).
Answer leakage is rare as only 0.44 % 0.44\% of concepts are flagged as containing the ground-truth answer, and only 3 % 3\% of problems contain any flagged concept; this proves that the gains cannot be explained by answer leakage ( section D.3 ).
Finally, when the total B = 128 B=128 answer-rollout budget is held fixed, increasing the number of concepts from one to ten raises pass@ 128 128 from 22.7 % 22.7\% to 39.8 % 39.8\% while pass@ 1 1 remains nearly unchanged, showing that distributing a fixed rollout budget across more concepts improves coverage of the solution space, especially at larger k k ( section D.4 ).

概念的准确性仍然在轨迹位置之间的狭小范围内,第2至10号位置的布局信任间隔大体重叠:没有位置死亡,支持我们使用轨迹级别的信用分配(D.2节)。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We revisited LLM exploration beyond naive repeated sampling. After showing that prior concept-guided gains largely disappear against an exploratory baseline, we introduced a stronger procedure that generates multiple detailed concepts in one trajectory and trains a small concept generator using the downstream success of a frozen answer generator. On hard mathematical problems, the learned policy roughly doubles pass@k at the same answer-rollout allocation, outperforms concepts from much larger untuned models, and transfers to an answer generator from a different model family. These results show that a small model can serve as an effective, reusable search policy for a larger model that may be impractical to train directly or closed-source.
blocks.zh: 我们重温LLM的探索 超越了天真的重复取样。 在表明先前的概念指导收益基本上在探索性基线下消失之后,我们采用了更强有力的程序,在一个轨迹中产生多种详细概念,并利用一个冷冻的解答生成器的下游成功来训练一个小概念生成器。 在困难的数学问题上,所学的策略大致是双倍通过@k 在同一解答-rollout 分配中,从大得多的未调试模型中超越概念,从不同的模型家族转移到一个解答生成器. 这些结果显示,一个小模型可以作为一种有效,可重复使用的搜索政策,用于一个可能不切实际的大型模型,直接训练或闭源训练.

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. Training is compute heavy because reward estimation requires many answer-generator rollouts, rewards are assigned at the trajectory level rather than to individual concepts, and our evaluation focuses on mathematical reasoning. Future work should develop lower-compute reward estimation, more granular credit assignment, judge-robust evaluation, and bandit based allocation of rollouts across concepts, while extending the approach to broader domains.

blocks.en: B.1 Concept Generator Prompt
blocks.zh: B.1 概念生成器提示

blocks.en: The concept generator is prompted to first analyze the problem and then enumerate a short list of high-signal, non-duplicated concepts, theorems, and creative problem-solving techniques, while being explicitly instructed not to solve the problem or reveal the final answer. The system and user messages are shown below.

blocks.en: Concept Generator Prompt ⬇ System : You are an expert mathematician . You will be given a mathematical problem . First , carefully analyze the problem : identify what type of problem it is , what mathematical structures are present , and what approaches might work . Then , list ALL relevant mathematical theorems , fundamental concepts , hints , and creative problem - solving techniques that could be useful for solving the problem . Do NOT solve the problem . Do NOT compute the final answer . OUTPUT FORMAT ( MUST FOLLOW EXACTLY ): First , write your analysis of the problem . Then , list concepts . Each concept line MUST start with exactly : #### After ’#### ’ write ONE concept / theorem or a sentence for the creative technique , for example : #### your concept or technique here . Each concept must be high - signal and specific enough ( avoid generic items like ’ algebra ’ or ’ logical reasoning ’). List between 1 and 10 concepts . NO DUPLICATES OR NEAR DUPLICATES . C.3 Concept Parsing
blocks.zh: C.3 概念分析

blocks.en: The CG prompt requires every concept to start with the delimiter #### . Parsing is regex-based and lenient: any analysis or preamble before the first #### is ignored, whitespace-only spans are dropped, and malformed text simply yields no matches rather than raising an error. We keep at most the first ten parsed concepts per trajectory ( max_concepts_per_trajectory = 10 \texttt{max\_concepts\_per\_trajectory}=10 ); when a trajectory exceeds this, its response tokens are truncated on-policy at the cut point so that the retained tokens keep their original conditional probabilities.
blocks.zh: CG 提示要求每个概念从 QQ 开始 。 解析是基于regex的且宽大:在第一个QQ之前的任何分析或序言都被忽略,只放弃白空的跨度,而错误的文本只是不产生匹配而不是引起错误. 我们最多保留每个轨迹的前十个解析概念( max_ concepts_ per_trajectory = 10\ texttt{max_ concepts_ per_trajectory = 10) ; 当一个轨迹超过这个轨迹时, 其反应符号在切点上被切换到政策上, 以便保留符记保持原来的有条件概率 。

blocks.en: Empty concept lists. A trajectory with no valid #### marker parses to an empty list. During training such trajectories generate no answer rollouts and receive a fixed penalty reward of − 0.1 -0.1 , which mildly discourages degenerate outputs; during validation they are replaced by a single empty concept so the pipeline still runs. We track the fraction of empty trajectories as a metric; in practice it stays at roughly 0 % 0\% throughout training, so parsing works out of the box.
blocks.zh: 空概念列表 。 无有效QQ标记的轨迹描述为空列表 。 在培训期间,这种轨迹不会产生答案,并获得0.1-0.1的固定惩罚奖励,这轻微地阻止了退化的产出;在验证期间,它们被一个单一的空概念所取代,因此管道仍在运行。 我们追踪空轨迹作为衡量标准;实际上,在整个训练中,空轨轨迹保持在0%左右,所以解析工作从盒子中解析出来。

blocks.en: Duplicates. Duplicate concepts are not removed for training or answer generation: identical concepts, if they appear, are treated as distinct list positions, i.e. we don’t apply any deduplication.
blocks.zh: 复次诸经. 重复的概念不为训练或回答生成而删除:相同的概念,如果出现,就被当作不同的列表位置,即我们不应用任何重复。

blocks.en: Length limits. If a single concept would exceed the remaining prompt allowed length (maximum prompt length minus the problem and template, with a small safety margin), it is truncated to fit.
blocks.zh: 长度限制。 如果单个概念将超过剩余允许的提示长度(最大提示长度减去问题和模板,安全幅度小),则切换以适应.

blocks.en: D.1 Training the Smaller Model Directly
blocks.zh: D.1 直接培训较小的模型

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Held-out pass@ k k on the 1k hard set: a 7B trained to answer directly, our trained 7B CG steering the 32B, and the untuned 7B CG steering the 32B.
blocks.zh: 图2:1k硬盘上的挂出传球@kk:一个7B训练直接回答,我们训练的7B CG驾驶32B,未调节的7B CG驾驶32B.

blocks.en:
A second question is whether the CG+AG setup is even necessary: could we instead simply train the small model to answer the hard problems on its own and skip the answer generator altogether? This matters because in our setting the AG is frozen and possibly closed-source, so the only trainable alternative is the small model itself.
To test this, we train an identical 7B model with the same RL algorithm, training split, and LLM judge, but with a direct answer objective, and compare it against our CG-steered 32B across the rollout allocation ( fig. 2 ).
Moreover, even the untuned 7B CG steering the 32B reaches 28.9 % 28.9\% pass@128, already above the trained direct-answer model. Training the small model to answer directly does not recover the performance of using it as a concept generator for a larger model: the value of our approach is injecting exploration into a stronger frozen answer generator at scale, not having the small model solve problems by itself. The direct-answer model does reach 16.3 % 16.3\% pass@1 (and 24.7 % 24.7\% pass@128) on problems where the 32B AG scored 0 % 0\% at 128 rollouts; this reflects the finite-sample nature of the filter (a different model recovers a fraction of these problems, section D.6 ) rather than genuine 0 % 0\% difficulty.
blocks.zh:
第二个问题是,CG+AG的设置是否必要:我们是否可以简单地训练这个小模型来单独回答困难的问题,并完全跳过答案生成器? 这很重要,因为在我们的设定中,AG是被冻结的,也可能是封闭的源,所以唯一可以训练的替代品是小模型本身.
为了测试这一点,我们用相同的RL算法,训练分化,LLM判官来训练一个相同的7B模型,但有一个直接的回答目标,并且将它与我们的CG-steered 32B在整个推出分配(图. (第2段)。
此外,即使未调节的7B CG引导32B也达到了28.9%的28.9%的通过@128,已经超过了训练有素的直接回答模式。 训练小模型直接回答并不能恢复使用它作为较大模型的概念生成器的性能:我们的方法的价值是将探索注入一个规模更强的冷冻解答生成器,而不是由小模型自行解决问题. 直接回答模式确实达到了16.3% 16.3% @1(和24.7% 24.7% @128),涉及32B AG在128推出时得分为0% 0.%的问题;这反映了滤波器的有限样本性质(不同的模型能回收一小部分这些问题,D.6节),而不是真正的0 % 0+%困难.

blocks.en: D.2 Position Bias Under Trajectory-Level Rewards
blocks.zh: D.2 轨迹-级别奖励下的职位偏差

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Per-concept accuracy by position in the trajectory (trained 7B CG, max-of-mean). Error bars are 95 % 95\% bootstrap CIs over the held-out problems ( 10,000 10{,}000 resamples, 2.5 / 97.5 2.5/97.5 percentiles).
blocks.zh: 图3:按轨迹位置分列的概念精确度(训练7B CG,最大平均值)。 错误栏为95% 95% 的靴子陷阱 CI , 相对于被搁置的问题 (10,000 10{,}000 个复标, 2.5/97.5 2.5/97.5 百分位数) 。

blocks.en:
Because the reward is assigned to the whole concept trajectory rather than to individual concepts ( section 5 ), weak concepts could in principle free-ride on strong ones, and the model could learn to pad later positions with filler. We check for this by measuring, for each position in the trajectory, the mean accuracy of the AG rollouts conditioned on the concept at that position (the same per-concept mean used by max-of-mean), averaged over the trajectories that contain a concept at that position. Coverage stays high throughout: every position is present in at least ∼ 89 % \sim\!89\% of trajectories (positions receive between 11,580 11{,}580 and 13,084 13{,}084 rollouts), so the pattern is not an artifact of missing late concepts.
Per-position accuracy varies only within a narrow band: it ranges from 1.3 % 1.3\% at the first concept to 2.7 % 2.7\% at the fifth, with all remaining positions clustered near 2 % 2\% . Crucially, no position is dead: every position yields correct solutions and none dominates.
The best position is only about twice the weakest, while positions 2–10 have broadly comparable estimated accuracies and overlapping bootstrap confidence intervals.
The first concept is the weakest, suggesting that useful ideas are not concentrated at the start.
This supports our use of trajectory-level credit: it does not degenerate into a few useful positions plus dead ones.
blocks.zh:
由于奖励被分配到整个概念轨迹而不是个别概念(第5节),弱概念原则上可以自由走在强概念上,模型可以学习用填充器支撑以后的位置. 我们通过测量轨道中每个位置的AG推出的平均准确性来检查这一点,其条件就是该位置的概念(最大值使用的相同每个概念的平均值),平均衡量该位置上包含一个概念的轨道。 覆盖率一直很高:每个位置至少存在于 \\ 89%\sim\!89\的轨迹中(位置接收到11,580 11{,}580和13,084 13{,}084 rolled),所以这个模式并不是缺失的过时概念的产物.
位置精度只在狭义的波段内有所不同:从第一个概念的1.3% 1.3%.到第五个概念的2.7% 2.7%.,其余所有位置都集中在近2%. 关键是,任何位置都不存在:每个位置都产生正确的解决方案,没有一个占据主导地位。
最佳位置只有最弱的两倍左右,而第2至第10位的位置则有大致可比较的估计强度和相互重叠的靴套置信间隔。
第一个概念是最弱的,说明有用的想法在开始时并不集中。
这支持我们使用轨迹一级的信用:它不会退化成几个有用的位置和死亡位置。

blocks.en: D.3 Answer Leakage
blocks.zh: D.3 答漏

blocks.en:
A natural worry is reward hacking: the concept generator could learn to solve each problem then pass the final answer into its “concepts,” in which case the downstream gains would reflect answer leakage rather than better exploration.
We test this directly by checking whether the ground-truth answer is present in the generated concepts. For each held-out problem we run an LLM judge (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) over each parsed concept and ask whether it states, or gives a value mathematically equivalent to, the ground-truth answer; the judge prompt is given in section B.6 . We deliberately avoid exact string matching, which produces spurious hits when the ground-truth answer is a short value that happens to coincide with unrelated text in a concept.
We find that only 0.44 % 0.44\% of concepts are flagged as containing the answer, and just 3 % 3\% of problems have at least one flagged concept. This confirms that the CG steers exploration rather than leaking solutions.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的担忧是奖励黑客:概念生成者可以学会解决每一个问题,然后将最后的答案传入它的“概念”,在这种情况下,下游收益将反映答案渗漏,而不是更好的探索。
我们通过检查生成的概念中是否存在地面真实的答案来直接测试这一点. 对于每个被搁置的问题,我们用一个LLM法官(Quen2.5-32B-Instructionct)来检查每个解析的概念,并询问它是否说明或给出了数学上相当于地面真相答案的价值;法官的提示载于B.6节。 我们故意避免精确的字符串匹配,当地面真实的答案是一个短暂的值,恰好与概念中无关的文本相吻合时,这会产生虚假的命中.
我们发现,只有0.44 % 0.44 % 的概念被标注为包含答案,只有3% 3 % 的问题至少有一个标注的概念。 这证实了CG引导探索而不是泄漏解决方案.

blocks.zh: D.4 概念数目的效果

blocks.en:
After training, the CG almost always still emits close to ten concepts (we truncate to the first ten), so the count does not collapse during training. To separate the value of using multiple concepts from the value of simply spending more compute, we hold the total answer allocation fixed. For each held-out problem, we first sample one generated concept uniformly at random, then incrementally sample additional concepts without replacement to form nested sets of sizes M ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 10 } M\in\{1,2,4,8,10\} . Thus every larger set retains all concepts from the smaller settings. At each M M , we split the same B = 128 B=128 rollout allocation as evenly as possible across the selected concepts (so M = 1 M=1 concentrates all 128 128 rollouts on one concept, whereas M = 10 M=10 assigns 12 12 or 13 13 rollouts to each).
Under this nested comparison, more concepts monotonically improve performance for k ≥ 4 k\geq 4 : pass@ 128 128 rises from 22.70 % 22.70\% with one concept to 28.10 % 28.10\% , 32.70 % 32.70\% , 36.50 % 36.50\% , and 39.80 % 39.80\% with 2 2 , 4 4 , 8 8 , and 10 10 concepts, respectively. pass@ 64 64 similarly rises from 16.87 % 16.87\% to 30.34 % 30.34\% ( fig. 4 ).
In contrast, pass@ 1 1 remains in the narrow range 2.15 2.15 – 2.44 % 2.44\% . This widening benefit with k k is the signature of improved exploration rather than single-shot accuracy: spreading a fixed allocation over additional, diverse concepts covers more of the solution space than repeatedly sampling from one. The incremental gains diminish as M M grows but remain positive through ten concepts. Because total compute is fixed and the concept sets are nested, the trend cannot be explained by extra sampling or by independently redrawing a more favorable subset at each M M : it directly supports our choice to generate many concepts rather than one.

blocks.en: D.8 Diversity of the Generated Reasoning
blocks.zh: D.8 产生理由的多样性

blocks.en: A central claim of our approach is that concept guidance improves exploration : it should yield genuinely different solution attempts rather than the near-duplicates produced by decoding noise alone. We test this directly by measuring the semantic diversity of the generated reasoning on the DeepMath val-hard held-out set.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法的一个中心主张是,概念指导可以改进探索:它应产生真正不同的解决方案尝试,而不是仅仅通过解码噪音产生的近似重复。 我们直接通过测量DeepMath val-hard hold-outs集上生成的推理的语义多样性来测试这一点.

blocks.en: Setup. For each problem we collect the model’s rollouts and embed only the chain-of-thought excluding the problem statement and the final answer, so that the score reflects the diversity of the reasoning itself rather than shared prompt text or a common answer. We use Qwen3-Embedding-8B [ Zhang et al., 2025 ] as the sentence embedder. On the resulting set of embeddings we compute the Vendi Score (VS) [ Friedman and Dieng, 2023 ] with an RBF kernel k ( x , y ) = exp ( − ∥ x − y ∥ 2 / ( 2 σ 2 ) ) k(x,y)=\exp\!\big(-\lVert x-y\rVert^{2}/(2\sigma^{2})\big) . The VS is the exponential of the Shannon entropy of the eigenvalues of the normalized kernel matrix and can be read as the effective number of distinct rollouts , so a higher VS means more diverse reasoning. We compute VS per problem and average over the held-out set.

blocks.en: Results. Table 11 reports the average VS at this bandwidth, and diversity increases exactly in the order our exploration story predicts. Naive repeated sampling is the least diverse ( 50.4 50.4 ), and perturbing the prompt with generic mathematical text barely helps ( 53.5 53.5 ). Conditioning on sampled concepts raises diversity substantially, whether the concepts come from the untuned 7B or 32B generator ( 63.3 63.3 and 62.9 62.9 , essentially tied). Training the concept generator increases it further: max-of-max reaches 66.3 66.3 , and our best method, max-of-mean, is the most diverse at 73.0 73.0 —a 45 % 45\% increase in effective distinct rollouts over the naive baseline. This ordering mirrors the pass@k gains in table 8 : methods that explore more diversely also solve more problems, supporting our claim that the gains come from broader exploration rather than prompt perturbation alone.

blocks.en: Our main results ( table 3 ) train the concept generator for 200 200 steps. Because each step is dominated by the G × B G\times B answer-generator rollouts needed to score the sampled concept trajectories ( section 7 ), we check whether this training length leaves performance on the table by continuing training well past it: max-of-max up to 750 750 steps and max-of-mean up to 900 900 ( fig. 7 ).

blocks.en: Performance largely saturates after the first few hundred steps. Both objectives climb steeply over the first ∼ 200 \sim\!200 steps and then plateau in a noisy band around 0.38 0.38 – 0.40 0.40 pass@128, with no sustained improvement thereafter. They differ mainly in how they reach this plateau: max-of-mean rises faster and is ahead at 200 200 steps ( 0.386 0.386 vs. 0.353 0.353 pass@128), whereas max-of-max catches up by ∼ 300 \sim\!300 steps, after which the two are indistinguishable within the run-to-run noise. The slower early progress of max-of-max is expected: its trajectory reward is binary ( 1 1 if any concept in the trajectory yields a correct answer and 0 0 otherwise) which, compounded by sampling noise, makes credit assignment harder and the learning signal less informative than the graded per trajectory success rate used by max-of-mean. Neither ever pulls clearly above the level already reached around 200 200 steps.
blocks.zh: 性能在前几百步后基本饱和. 两个目标都陡然越过了最初的200 \ sim\!200步,然后在大约0.38 0.38 — 040 040 传球@ 128的吵闹带中高原,此后没有持续改善。 它们主要在如何到达这一高原上有所不同:最大平均上升速度更快,领先200步(0.386 0.386对0.353 0.353通过@128),而最大最大追赶速度则达到 XXX 300\sim\!300步,之后两者在跑到跑的噪音中无法区分. 最大功率的早期进展较慢:其轨迹奖励为二进制(如果轨迹中的任何概念得出正确答案为11,否则为0),再加上取样噪音,使得信用分配更加困难,学习信号比最大功率使用的每轨迹成功率分级的学习信号信息较少. 也从未明显超过已经达到约200200步的水平。

blocks.en: The two objectives do differ in late-training stability. max-of-max stays within the plateau band through 750 750 steps, whereas max-of-mean grows increasingly volatile and collapses sharply around step 750 750 (pass@128 dropping to ≈ 0.28 \approx\!0.28 ), recovering only partially afterwards. This collapse reflects a training instability rather than genuine overfitting: around the same point the policy entropy rises sharply and the concept generator increasingly emits over-long trajectories that hit the generation-length limit and are truncated before producing a stop token (the truncation rate climbs to ≈ 60 % \approx\!60\% near step 720 720 ), alongside a growing KL divergence from the reference policy. Such truncated concept trajectories are malformed and score poorly downstream, dragging pass@128 down. Together, these observations justify our 200 200 -step schedule: it captures essentially all of the attainable gain at a fraction of the compute, and stopping early avoids the instability that eventually affects max-of-mean.
blocks.zh: 这两项目标在培训后期稳定性方面确实有所不同。 最大值通过750 750步停留在高原带内,而最大值则在750 750步左右发生剧烈波动和崩溃(通过@128下降到 0.28 \ 大约 0.28),之后才部分恢复。 这一崩溃反映了训练不稳定,而不是真正过度适应:就在同一点上,政策entropy急剧上升,概念生成者越来越多地释放出超长的轨迹,这些轨迹撞击了发电长度的限制,并在生产停止符前被截断(截断率攀升到~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~接近步骤720 720),同时KL与参考政策的差距越来越大. 这种短短的概念轨迹畸形,下游得分差,拖过@128. 这些观察结果共同证明了我们200200步时间表的合理性:它基本上以计算数的一小部分来捕捉所有可实现的收益,并及早制止最终影响最大目的的不稳定。

Example 2: Distributing balls with capacity constraints Problem. blocks.en: Example 4: Constant-speed elevators (relative motion) Problem. Four elevators in a skyscraper, each a different color (red, blue, green, and yellow), move at constant speeds in various directions. The following events were observed: at 36 36 seconds the red elevator caught up with the blue one; at 42 42 seconds the red elevator passed the green one; at 48 48 seconds the red elevator passed the yellow one; at 51 51 seconds the yellow elevator passed the blue one; at 54 54 seconds the yellow elevator caught up with the green one. Determine the time, in seconds from the start, when the green elevator will pass the blue one. Ground truth: 46 46 . Untuned 7B CG • Determine the relative speeds between pairs of elevators. • Construct a system of equations based on the observed events. • Plot the positions of the elevators as functions of time. Trained max-of-mean • Introduce a coordinate system where one elevator is at rest to simplify the problem. Choose the blue elevator as the reference frame. Rewrite the positions and speeds of the other elevators relative to the blue elevator.
